info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Retail Orders Tracks-v1-spec
info.description: The Retail Orders Tracking API provides insights into the status and progress of retail orders. By accessing this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed tracking information for their orders, enabling effective order management and customer support. Typical consumers of this API include retailers and logistics providers looking to optimize their order fulfillment processes. This operation facilitates real-time visibility into order movement, assisting businesses in delivering improved service to their customers.

get.summary: Track the status of an order
get.description: This endpoint allows users to track the status of their orders by providing the relevant order ID. You'll receive the current status and expected delivery details for the specified order.

requestBody.description: Contains parameters necessary to track an order. Ensure the request body conforms to the provided schema for accurate processing.

ListRetailOrdersTracksRequest.description: A string representing the request body for the GET operation on orders tracking.

status.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: The reference number associated with the order tracking.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the tracking operation.

state.description: The current state of the order being tracked.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the tracking request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the tracking outcome.

audit.description: Metadata related to the audit of the tracking operation.

ListRetailOrdersTracksResponse_201.description: Response schema for the successful tracking operation for orders.

createdBy.description: The identifier of the user or system that created the tracking record.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the tracking record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the tracking operation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Information regarding the audit of the tracking operation.

x-processing-time.description: The time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. Useful for performance monitoring.
